title: 🔬 Supercomputing Mission — ‘PARAM SHAKTI’ Supercomputer (PARAM RUDRA Architecture) at IIT Madras
summary: MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan inaugurated PARAM SHAKTI supercomputing facility powered by indigenous PARAM RUDRA servers developed by C-DAC under National Supercomputing Mission.
